```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Task 1

```{r}
host_counts <- listings |> 
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listing_count")

listings_with_counts <- listings |> 
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

host_counts |> 
  dplyr::filter(host_listing_count >= 10) |> 
  nrow()

listings_with_counts |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct = 100 * mean(host_listing_count >= 10))
```

##Task 2

```{r}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_ppp = median(price_per_person),
    n_listings = dplyr::n()
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Columbus",
    n_listings >= 20
  ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(median_ppp)
```

##Task 3

```{r}
listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  )
```

##Task 4
```{r}
listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(city, dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    is_top_10 = rank <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_pct_rev = 100 * sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[is_top_10], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

##Task 5
```{r}
oct_avail <- availability |> 
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(oct_avail, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    share_mostly_taken = 100 * mean(mostly_taken)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(share_mostly_taken)
```

##Task 6
```{r}
city_monthly_reviews <- reviews |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(listings, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities")

# [A8] Busiest month (month with maximum total reviews)
city_monthly_reviews |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

# [A9] Ratio of busiest month reviews to quietest month reviews
city_monthly_reviews |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    ratio = max(total_reviews) / min(total_reviews)
  )
```

##Task 7
```{r}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost),
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    superhost_price = median_price[host_is_superhost == "t"],
    other_price = median_price[host_is_superhost == "f"],
    premium = superhost_price - other_price
  )
```

##Task 8
```{r}
listings |> 
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id") |> 
  nrow()

listings |> 
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::count(city, name = "missing_count") |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(missing_count))
```


##B2

```{r}
# Task 1 Share: % of listings held by hosts with >= 10 total listings across all cities
large_hosts <- listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(host_id) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(total_host_listings = dplyr::n()) |> 
  dplyr::filter(total_host_listings >= 10)

listings |> 
  dplyr::mutate(is_large_host = host_id %in% large_hosts$host_id) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct_listings_large_host = 100 * mean(is_large_host)
  )

# Task 4 Share: % of city revenue earned by top 10% highest-earning listings
listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(city, dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    is_top_10 = rank <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_pct_rev = 100 * sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[is_top_10], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
